misconfig_patterns: auth=check_auth if (args.share or args.listen) and auth_enabled else None — auth only engages when BOTH a network-exposure flag is set AND an auth.json file exists; the common '--listen' launch recipe alone ships fully unauth
Operators expose --listen 0.0.0.0 (or --listen with a bind IP) without ever creating auth.json — auth_enabled defaults false, so the conditional never triggers
GET / discloses gr.Blocks title 'Fooocus {version}' — version-fingerprintable without auth
GET /config discloses full Gradio component graph: installed presets, model/LoRA dropdown contents, style list, resolution presets, advanced params — operator's model/LoRA library disclosure
POST /api/predict and /queue/join accept arbitrary generation jobs — compute theft on operator GPU

GET /file=<path> (Gradio file-serving route) can read files under the allowed_paths root (modules.config.path_outputs is explicitly allow-listed; constants.AUTH_FILENAME is explicitly block-listed, implying other paths were NOT hardened before that patch)

CVE-2025-31114 (GHSL-2024-196): load_parameter_button_click() feeds EXIF-embedded JSON metadata from an uploaded image into eval() via get_list()/get_resolution()/get_adm_guidance()/get_freeu() — RCE on any user (unauth or not) who can reach the 'load metadata from image' UI action; no CVSS assigned; unpatched at disclosure, upstream unresponsive since Aug 2024, public fix PR posted 2026-07-24
--share flag registers a public *.gradio.live tunnel — auth conditional applies here too, so shared links are unauth by default unless auth.json exists

active_probe.false_positive_check: Generic Gradio /config returns the same JSON shape (theme, components, version) for ANY Gradio app — the distinguishing marker is the "title" value starting with "Fooocus" (embeds fooocus_version.version at build time), not the presence of /config itself. Confirm against GET / HTML <title> tag matching before labeling Fooocus vs. generic Gradio/other-Gradio-app-on-7860.

deployment_tells: Default port 7865 (GRADIO_SERVER_PORT env set by launch.py if unset) distinguishes stock Fooocus from generic Gradio's 7860 default — a 7865 hit is Fooocus-likely before any content check; a 7860 hit requires title/content disambiguation against the already-surveyed generic-Gradio population (gradio-port-7860-survey-2026-05.md)
GPU-rental / cloud-proxy deployments (RunPod, Vast.ai, Colab-tunneled) commonly remap the port — same population-skew pattern documented for ComfyUI; port-7865-only dorking will undercount

Fooocus-API (mrhan1993/Fooocus-API) fork wraps stock Fooocus with a FastAPI layer on a separate port and exposes /v1/generation/* + /docs (OpenAPI/Swagger) — distinct install, distinct fingerprint, should be tracked as a related-but-separate platform entry if population is material
SimpleSDXL (metercai/SimpleSDXL) is a Fooocus fork targeting Chinese-market cloud deployment — will title-fingerprint differently, worth a follow-up dork variant
--share mode instances live on *.gradio.live subdomains, not the operator's own IP — requires Gradio-share-link enumeration, not IP-space scanning, to find
pivot_paths: GET /config → full component graph: model list, LoRA list, style presets, resolution presets, default params (operator model-library disclosure)
POST /api/predict, POST /queue/join → arbitrary generation job submission (compute theft on operator GPU)
GET /file=<path within allow-listed output dir> → generated image output retrieval (product-IP / prompt-content disclosure via EXIF metadata embedded in outputs)
Upload-metadata-from-image UI action → CVE-2025-31114 eval() RCE chain (get_list/get_resolution/get_adm_guidance/get_freeu) → full instance compromise, pivot to host/GPU
Fooocus-API fork: GET /docs → OpenAPI schema → POST /v1/generation/text-to-image and siblings → same compute-theft class via REST instead of Gradio queue protocol
vulnerabilities: CVE-2025-31114 / GHSL-2024-196 — Remote Code Execution via unsafe eval() on image-EXIF-embedded metadata JSON, reachable through the 'load parameter from image' feature in load_parameter_button_click(); reported by Kevin Stubbings (GitHub Security Lab), issue opened 2024-08-21, maintainer unresponsive through private disclosure 2024-10-02, public fix PR posted 2026-07-24; no CVSS published, no confirmed patched release as of this survey
No-auth-by-design baseline — auth is opt-in via auth.json AND requires --listen/--share to even be checked; the framework ships with no forced auth gate on network exposure
